title: adlc-human-feedback/v1
description: Structured human feedback captured on report.html and submitted as one act. It is UNTRUSTED input: it is authored in a browser, may be hand-edited, and its rendered form is read by agents in the successor run. Hence additionalProperties:false everywhere and a hard length cap on every free-text field. Possession of a pack confers NO authority - in CI it must arrive via a native PR review or workflow_dispatch, both of which require write permission.

candidateSha.description: The headSha the reviewer actually saw. A pack whose candidateSha is not the run's headSha is refused, never silently applied. Empty is permitted only because current_sha() yields '' outside a git checkout; ingestion still compares it against the run.

reportDigest.description: Digest of the report.html that produced this pack. Detects feedback authored against a stale rendering.

packDigest.description: Digest of the canonical pack with this field removed. Integrity only - not a signature and not an authorisation.

submittedBy.description: Self-declared. Advisory only; real identity comes from the GitHub review that carries the pack.

verdict.description: accept -> ship, reject -> do_not_ship, revise -> iterate.

route.description: Which loop the successor run re-enters. outer re-specs; inner only re-implements.

digest.description: An algorithm-prefixed digest. A field that merely claims to be a digest without constraining its shape is a lie in the contract, so the prefix is required.

annotation.description: Visual markup anchored to a specific evidence artifact.

artifactSha256.description: Citation-or-discard: an annotation naming a hash absent from run.artifacts is dropped and recorded.

geometry.description: Normalised to the artifact's NATURAL size, so a reviewer's viewport width can never change what the annotation means. Omitted for shape 'whole'.

timestampMs.description: Playback offset for a time-based artifact (video). Null for still images.

critique.description: A judgement on agent-authored reasoning: squad findings, personas, rubric rationales, ADR justifications.

sourceDigest.description: Digest of the exact reasoning text critiqued, so drift between critique and source is detectable.

diffDecision.description: Accept or reject one evidence-vs-baseline delta.

targetId.description: metricId, screenshot relative path, or requirementId.
